title: Simplify the editor empty state to a plain hint, dropping the icon/card treatment
description: Address item 4 of `novas-tasks.md` (`referencia-5.png`): replace `EditorEmptyState.tsx`'s current card-style empty state (`FilePlus2` icon, 'Página em branco' title, description, and an 'Adicionar conteúdo' button that opens the `BLOCK_GROUPS` dropdown) with a single, unobtrusive line of muted placeholder text telling the user to start typing and that markdown works — matching the plain 'Type something or type / for commands' style shown in `referencia-5.png`. No icon, no card/border, no button.
acceptanceCriteria: `EditorEmptyState.tsx` no longer renders the `EmptyState` icon/card/button treatment
An empty page shows a single muted line of placeholder-style text prompting the user to start typing and mentioning markdown support (and, once TASK-104 lands, that '/' opens the block menu)
The placeholder disappears as soon as the user starts typing, same as before
No dead imports remain (`EmptyState` wrapper usage, `FilePlus2` icon) if fully unused after this change

steps.details: In `EditorEmptyState.tsx`, remove the icon/card/button and render simple muted placeholder text instead, styled consistently with the rest of the editor typography.
Remove now-unused imports (`EmptyState` wrapper, `FilePlus2`, `BLOCK_GROUPS` dropdown trigger) if nothing else in the file references them.
Open a blank page, confirm the simplified placeholder renders and disappears on typing, and that visual style matches `referencia-5.png`.

technicalNotes: Depends on TASK-103 so the placeholder copy and surrounding chrome are consistent with the borderless, toolbar-free content area landed there.
